# SARCTrac Mk4 FreeCAD files (SARCNET)

- **What:** the original SARCTrac Mk4 FreeCAD model (`FreeCAD/`, main file `Rotator.FCStd`), part files, STEP files of bought parts and the 23 PDF drawings, unchanged.
- **Source:** SARCNET, <https://www.sarcnet.org/sarctrac-mk4.html>, obtained through the FreeCAD request page (<https://www.sarcnet.org/freecad-request.html>); files last updated 28 May 2024 according to that page.
- **Licence:** MIT ([LICENSE](LICENSE)). The public page carries no licence text, only an as-is disclaimer; SARCNET confirmed the MIT licence to the project owner (BricoHams) on 2026-11-18. The owner keeps that confirmation on file.
- **Integrity:** `SHA256SUMS` lists every file as received.
- **Use in this repository:** LSR-2 replicates the Mk4 form and design (see [docs/LSR2_MK4.md](../../docs/LSR2_MK4.md)). Our own code reads dimensions from these files; the files themselves stay as SARCNET published them. Credit: SARCNET, SARCTrac Mk4.
